messages:
alex: Heads up — planning a staged rollout to upgrade runtime kernels on Dedicated (eu-west-1) tonight 23:00-00:30 UTC. Low-risk but will require short pod restarts. Posting drafts for statuspage + enterprise email here.

maya: thanks. are we pinning any customer routes or models during the window?

alex: yes pinning recommended for heavy customers. we'll pin to v2.3.1 for 2 hours post-upgrade, then lift if metrics look good. rollout plan: stage by region, 5% -> 25% -> 100% with 15m observation per stage.

sam: draft status page update below (TL;DR at top). please review wording.

sam: [STATUSPAGE DRAFT]
- Incident type: Scheduled maintenance
- Impact: Short request restarts for Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 during maintenance window. No data loss expected.
- When: 2025-11-12 23:00–00:30 UTC
- What we’re doing: Kernel upgrades and runtime patching to improve latencies and stability
- Customer action: No action required. We will pin heavy customer routes to v2.3.1 during the window as a precaution.
- Fallback: Automatic rollback to previous runtime if error rate > 5% or latency SLO breaches
- Contact: support@redwood.ai / status.redwood.ai

lina: small nit — change "request restarts" to "short in-flight request interruptions" and add link to KB for pinning procedures: https://intra.redwood.ai/kb/dedicated-pinning

sam: updated. also adding a short code snippet for status widget: 

sam: ```
{
  "id": "maintenance-1758201234",
  "status": "scheduled",
  "starts_at": "2025-11-12T23:00:00Z",
  "description": "Short in-flight request interruptions for Dedicated customers in eu-west-1 while we apply runtime kernel upgrades."
}
```

deploy-bot: Deploy initiated by @alex — job id 873201. Stage 1 (5%) scheduled at 2025-11-12T23:00:00Z.

support-ops: Enterprise email draft below. Keep it short, send to accounts with >$5k/mo and dedicated contracts.

support-ops: [EMAIL DRAFT]
Subject: Planned maintenance: Dedicated runtime upgrade (eu-west-1) — Nov 12 23:00 UTC
Hi {{account_owner}},
We will be performing a routine runtime kernel upgrade in eu-west-1 on Nov 12 at 23:00 UTC. During this 90-minute window you may observe brief interruptions to in-flight requests for Dedicated capacity. No data will be lost.
If your workloads require additional isolation, we will pin your traffic to runtime v2.3.1 between 23:00–01:00 UTC; let us know if you prefer extended pinning.
We'll monitor token throughput and tail latencies; if any regression occurs we will rollback automatically and notify you.
Thanks,
Redwood Support

maya: looks good. alex — are we sending a proactive DM to top 10 customers as well?

alex: yes @support-ops to DM top10 at 22:30 UTC with the email copy. support-ops please add a short note about contact SLA if they need immediate rollback.

support-ops: confirmed — will DM and attach rollback contact instructions.

alex: final checklist:
- [x] Status page draft (sam)
- [x] Enterprise email (support-ops)
- [x] Pinning plan documented (lina) https://intra.redwood.ai/kb/dedicated-pinning
- [x] Deploy bot scheduled (deploy-bot)
- [ ] Post-maintenance verification: alex/slo-team to validate 10m tail latency and error rate for 1h after full rollout

alex: if no objections by 22:00 UTC we'll proceed. :thumbsup:
